All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BffLoginController
Starts the OpenID Connect login, as the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated LoginApi.
BffLoginExceptionHandler
Answers a login request whose parameters break the constraints of the contract (returnTo too long, acrValues of the wrong format, maxAge out of range) with 400, as the contract declares: the validation of the generated interface throws a ConstraintViolationException, which would otherwise be a 500.
BffLoginProperties
Configuration of the BFF login (bff.login.*).
CsrfCookieFilter
Makes the CSRF token reach the single page application.
DocumentDtoMapper
Maps the domain documents onto the DTO generated from the contract; a controller never returns a domain model.
DocumentResponse
A document owned by a user, as the resource server keeps it.
DocumentsApi
 
DocumentsController
Lists and deletes the documents of the signed-in user, as the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml describes them through the generated DocumentsApi.
DocumentsExceptionHandler
Translates the failures of DocumentsController to RFC 9457 problem details.
LoginApi
 
LogoutConfiguration
Wires the OpenID Connect RP-initiated logout of the BFF.
OpenApiConfig
Runtime OpenAPI document of the JSON API of the BFF, served by springdoc at "/v3/api-docs" to a signed-in user.
Problem
RFC 9457 problem details of a failed call to the documents, answered as application/problem+json.
ReturnToAuthenticationSuccessHandler
Sends the browser, once the OAuth2 login has succeeded, back to the returnTo that BffLoginController validated and kept in the session.
ReturnToValidator
Decides whether a returnTo value asked by the browser is a safe place to send it back to after the login.
SecurityConfig
Signs users in with OAuth2 / OpenID Connect login and out with the RP-initiated logout of the authorization server.
SessionUserDtoMapper
Maps the OpenID Connect user of the BFF session onto the DTO generated from the contract.
SessionUserResponse
The user signed in to the BFF session
StepUpAuthorizationRequestResolver
Adds the step-up values that BffLoginController kept in the session to the authorization request built by the delegate, as the OpenID Connect acr_values and max_age parameters, and forgets them, so they apply to one login only.
StepUpLoginParameters
Step-up values of a login (RFC 9470), kept in the session by BffLoginController until StepUpAuthorizationRequestResolver adds them to the authorization request.
StepUpProblemMapper
Maps a step-up request of the resource server onto the extra members of the step-up-required problem, the values the SPA passes back to GET /bff/login.
UserApi
 
UserController
Exposes the authenticated user, as the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated UserApi.
